description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss Ratio (%) and TFLOPS for several models. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPS” and spans a linear scale from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick marks every 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and spans a linear scale from 94 to 100, with tick marks every 1.

The “Vanilla” model is represented by a purple line with triangle markers. Starting at a value of approximately 99.1 at 1e7 TFLOPS, it decreases slightly to 98.8 at 2e7 TFLOPS, then increases and plateaus around 99.6 for the remainder of the x-axis range. The “SepLLM (n=64)” model is represented by an orange line with circle markers. It begins at approximately 98.1 at 1e7 TFLOPS, increases to roughly 99.2 at 2e7 TFLOPS, and continues to increase, leveling off around 99.6 from 5e8 TFLOPS onwards. The “SepLLM (n=128)” model is represented by a blue line with cross markers. The line starts at approximately 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPS, increases to roughly 99.2 at 2e7 TFLOPS, and stabilizes around 99.6 for the higher TFLOPS values. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” model is represented by a green line with diamond markers. It begins at approximately 97.8 at 1e7 TFLOPS and shows an increasing trend, reaching around 99.4 at 2e7 TFLOPS and then stabilizes near 99.6 for larger values of TFLOPS. Finally, the “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” model is depicted by a red line with square markers. This line starts at approximately 94.2 at 1e7 TFLOPS and increases steadily to roughly 98.5 at 2e7 TFLOPS, and continuing to approximately 98.8 at 9e8 TFLOPS.
